additional_context: ElementDefinition remains active and normative in source/fhir.ini. Current source keeps the single-preferred-label definition and, after FHIR-41757, uses the short description "String to display with or prompt for element". The FHIR Extension Pack carries elementdefinition-question for alternate question prompts and elementdefinition-translatable for translation expectations. FHIR-10956 is already audited on the combined branch and supports not adding a separate designation structure.
